MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

2. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 50

3. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

4. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 12
   C. 2
   D. 14

6. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 57
   C. 15
   D. 1

7. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 9

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 170

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 121

11. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 5
   C. 16
   D. 11

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: 7² = 7 × 7
3. 7² = 49
Final Answer: 49
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. C — 10

5. A — 10
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 6² + 8²
3. c² = 36 + 64
4. c² = 100
5. c = 10
Final Answer: 10 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse
